name: Zerion
description: Onchain wallet data from the Zerion API for EVM chains and Solana: portfolio value, token and DeFi positions, decoded transaction history, profit and loss, balance charts, NFTs, token prices and charts, supported chains and gas prices. Read-only.
instructions:
## Zerion
This connector reads onchain wallet data from the **Zerion API** (`https://api.zerion.io/v1`) for EVM chains and Solana: portfolio value, token and DeFi positions, decoded transactions, profit and loss, balance charts, NFTs, token prices and charts, chains and gas prices. Everything is read-only: nothing is signed or sent, and the swap, webhook-subscription and wallet-set endpoints are not part of this connector.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign up at https://dashboard.zerion.io and create an API key (a free developer plan exists).
2. Paste the key into `ZERION_API_KEY`. Zerion takes it as HTTP Basic auth: the key is the user name and the password stays empty.
3. Run `zerion_list_chains` to check the key.

**Workflow**
- What a wallet holds: `zerion_get_wallet_portfolio` for the totals by type and chain, `zerion_list_wallet_positions` for each token (set `positions: no_filter` to include DeFi positions such as lending, staking and liquidity, or `only_complex` for DeFi only).
- History: `zerion_list_wallet_transactions` (filter by chain, operation type, token or time), `zerion_get_wallet_chart` for the balance over time, `zerion_get_wallet_pnl` for realized and unrealized gains.
- NFTs (EVM wallets): `zerion_list_wallet_nft_positions`, `zerion_list_wallet_nft_collections`, `zerion_get_wallet_nft_portfolio`.
- Tokens: `zerion_list_fungibles` with `search_query` to find a token and its fungible id, then `zerion_get_fungible` or `zerion_get_fungible_chart`; `zerion_get_fungible_by_implementation` when you have a chain and contract address.
- Chains and fees: `zerion_list_chains`, `zerion_get_chain`, `zerion_list_gas_prices`.

**Reading the answers**: responses follow JSON:API: `data` holds the items, each with `id`, `attributes` and `relationships` (chain and fungible ids). Quantities come as `quantity.float` (human units) next to the raw integer. Values and prices are in the requested `currency` (USD by default). Times in `mined_at` and `updated_at` are ISO 8601; chart points are `[unix_seconds, value]`; time filters (`min_mined_at`, `since`, ...) take Unix milliseconds.

**Paging**: list tools return `links.next` when more items exist. Take the `page[after]` value out of that URL and pass it as `page_after`; stop when `links.next` is missing.

**Filters** that take several values (`chain_ids`, `fungible_ids`, `operation_types`, ...) are comma-separated, without spaces.

**Limits**: requests per second, per day and per month depend on the plan (the free Developer plan allows 2,000 requests a day at 3 per second; see the Dashboard). Positions with `only_complex` or `no_filter`, wallet charts and PnL count toward an advanced quota of 25% of the monthly requests; when it is used up those calls answer 429 while the others keep working. The NFT tools may first answer 202 while a wallet's NFTs are being indexed: wait a few seconds and ask again.

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong key, 400 an invalid address or filter (PnL and transactions also refuse contract and exchange hot-wallet addresses), 429 a rate limit or quota.
prerequisites: A Zerion API key from dashboard.zerion.io (the developer plan is free).

ZERION_API_KEY.label: API key
ZERION_API_KEY.help: dashboard.zerion.io, API keys: the key of your project. It is sent as the Basic auth user name with an empty password.
ZERION_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces, quotes or a Basic prefix.

verifyHints.401: Zerion refused the API key. Copy it again from dashboard.zerion.io; paste the key itself, not the Base64 Basic header.
verifyHints.429: The rate limit or the monthly quota of your Zerion plan is used up. Check usage in the Zerion Dashboard.

tools.name: zerion_get_wallet_portfolio
tools.description: Total value of a wallet across all chains, split by position type (wallet, deposited, borrowed, locked, staked) and by chain, with the absolute and percent change over 24 hours.

address.description: Wallet address: an EVM address (0x...) or a Solana address. ENS names are not resolved.

positions.description: only_simple (default): tokens held directly in the wallet; only_complex: DeFi protocol positions only; no_filter: both. only_complex and no_filter count toward Zerion's advanced-request quota.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_list_wallet_positions
tools.description: Every token and DeFi position of a wallet across chains: name, symbol, chain (relationships.chain.data.id), position type, quantity, price, value and 24 hour change, protocol and dapp for DeFi positions. Sorted by value, highest first. Spam tokens are left out by default.

address.description: Wallet address: an EVM address (0x...) or a Solana address. ENS names are not resolved.

positions.description: only_simple (default): tokens held directly in the wallet; only_complex: DeFi protocol positions only; no_filter: both. only_complex and no_filter count toward Zerion's advanced-request quota.

position_types.description: Only these position types, comma-separated: wallet, deposit, loan, locked, staked, reward, investment.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

fungible_ids.description: Only these fungible ids, comma-separated (the id from zerion_list_fungibles or a position's fungible_info.id).

dapp_ids.description: Only positions in these dapps, comma-separated dapp ids (e.g. aave-v3, uniswap-v3).

trash.description: Spam filter: only_non_trash (default) leaves spam out, only_trash shows only spam, no_filter shows both.

sort.description: value (default) for highest value first, -value for lowest first.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_list_wallet_transactions
tools.description: Decoded transaction history of a wallet across chains, newest first: hash, chain, time (mined_at), operation type (send, receive, trade, deposit, withdraw, approve, mint, ...), status, fee, every transfer with token, direction, quantity and value, and the dapp. Page with page_after from links.next.

address.description: Wallet address: an EVM address (0x...) or a Solana address. ENS names are not resolved.

operation_types.description: Only these operation types, comma-separated: approve, bid, burn, claim, delegate, deploy, deposit, execute, mint, receive, revoke, revoke_delegation, send, trade, withdraw.

asset_types.description: Only transactions moving these asset types, comma-separated: fungible, nft.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

fungible_ids.description: Only these fungible ids, comma-separated (the id from zerion_list_fungibles or a position's fungible_info.id).

fungible_implementations.description: Only these tokens by chain and contract, comma-separated chain_id:address pairs, e.g. ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48.

min_mined_at.description: Only transactions mined at or after this time, Unix milliseconds.

max_mined_at.description: Only transactions mined at or before this time, Unix milliseconds.

search_query.description: Full-text search, 2 to 64 characters (token, dapp or address).

trash.description: Spam filter: no_filter (default) returns all, only_non_trash leaves spam out, only_trash shows only spam.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value inside links.next of the previous answer. Leave empty for the first page.

tools.name: zerion_get_wallet_pnl
tools.description: Profit and loss of a wallet (FIFO): realized and unrealized gain, total gain, net invested, cost basis, fees, and relative gains in percent. Optionally only some chains or tokens, or sales in a time window. Needs a wallet Zerion tracks (not a token contract or exchange hot wallet).

address.description: Wallet address: an EVM address (0x...) or a Solana address. ENS names are not resolved.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

fungible_ids.description: Only these fungible ids, comma-separated (the id from zerion_list_fungibles or a position's fungible_info.id).

fungible_implementations.description: Only these tokens by chain and contract, comma-separated chain_id:address pairs, e.g. ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48.

since.description: Count only sales since this time, Unix milliseconds.

till.description: Count only sales until this time, Unix milliseconds.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_get_wallet_chart
tools.description: Balance of a wallet over time for a period: begin_at, end_at and points as [unix_seconds, value]. Optionally only some chains or tokens, or including DeFi positions.

address.description: Wallet address: an EVM address (0x...) or a Solana address. ENS names are not resolved.

chart_period.description: Chart period; it sets both the window and the spacing of the points.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

fungible_ids.description: Only these fungible ids, comma-separated (the id from zerion_list_fungibles or a position's fungible_info.id).

exclude_fungible_ids.description: Leave these fungible ids out, comma-separated. Not together with fungible_ids.

positions.description: only_simple (default): tokens held directly in the wallet; only_complex: DeFi protocol positions only; no_filter: both. only_complex and no_filter count toward Zerion's advanced-request quota.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_list_wallet_nft_positions
tools.description: NFTs held by an EVM wallet: token id, collection, name, amount, media and floor price. Page with page_after from links.next.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

sort.description: created_at or floor_price, with a leading minus for descending.

include.description: Related data to include, comma-separated: nfts, nft_collections, wallet_nft_collections.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value inside links.next of the previous answer. Leave empty for the first page.

tools.name: zerion_list_wallet_nft_collections
tools.description: NFT collections held by an EVM wallet with the number of NFTs and the total floor price per collection.

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

include.description: nft_collections to include the collection details.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_get_wallet_nft_portfolio
tools.description: Total value of the NFTs of an EVM wallet, summed from floor prices across chains.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_list_fungibles
tools.description: Search and list tokens: name, symbol, price, market cap, supply, price changes over 1, 30, 90 and 365 days, volume, asset class, and the contract per chain (implementations). Use search_query to find a token's fungible id. Page with page_after from links.next.

search_query.description: Name, symbol or address to search, 1 to 66 characters.

implementation_chain_id.description: Only tokens on this chain id.

implementation_address.description: Only tokens deployed at this contract address.

fungible_implementations.description: Only these tokens by chain and contract, comma-separated chain_id:address pairs, e.g. ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48.

fungible_ids.description: Only these fungible ids, comma-separated (the id from zerion_list_fungibles or a position's fungible_info.id).

asset_class.description: Only these asset classes, comma-separated: stablecoin, tokenized_stock, tokenized_treasury, commodity, other_financial, other_non_financial, unknown.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value inside links.next of the previous answer. Leave empty for the first page.

tools.name: zerion_get_fungible
tools.description: One token by its Zerion fungible id: name, symbol, description, price, market cap, supply, price changes, volume and contracts per chain.

fungible_id.description: Zerion fungible id, e.g. eth or the id from zerion_list_fungibles.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_get_fungible_by_implementation
tools.description: One token by chain and contract address, without knowing its Zerion id: same data as zerion_get_fungible.

implementation.description: chain_id:address, e.g. ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, or just the chain id for its native coin.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_get_fungible_chart
tools.description: Price chart of a token for a period: begin_at, end_at, stats (first, min, avg, max, last) and points as [unix_seconds, price].

chart_period.description: Chart period; it sets both the window and the spacing of the points.

currency.description: Currency for values and prices: usd (default), eur, gbp, chf, eth, btc, ...

tools.name: zerion_list_chains
tools.description: List the chains Zerion supports: chain id (the value other tools take in chain_ids), name, native token, explorer and flags telling which data (positions, transactions, NFTs) the chain supports.

tools.name: zerion_get_chain
tools.description: One chain by its id: name, native token, explorer and supported features.

chain_id.description: Chain id, e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana.

tools.name: zerion_list_gas_prices
tools.description: Current gas prices per chain at each speed (slow, standard, fast, ...), by gas type (classic, eip1559, optimistic).

chain_ids.description: Only these chains, comma-separated chain ids from zerion_list_chains, e.g. ethereum,base,arbitrum,solana.

gas_types.description: Only these gas types, comma-separated: classic, eip1559, optimistic.
